_comment: Scene manifest for Tier B. Paths are relative to this file.
Copy this, point it at a real dataset, and pass it as --manifest.
tau is the F-score threshold in the dataset's own units; DTU's convention
is 2 mm. State it in every table -- an F-score without a tau is not
interpretable. If gt_path is a COLMAP dense reconstruction rather than
sensor ground truth, say so in notes and label it pseudo-GT in the paper.
For B4, image_dir must hold an extracted video sequence in capture order
with more than MAX_RECONSTRUCTION_FRAMES (40) frames, otherwise the
budget never fires and all three variants are identical.
